items.headline: What Albemarle (ALB)'s Profits Rebound and Higher 2026 Outlook Means For Shareholders
items.snippet: Q2 2026 earnings rebound, reaffirmed $5.7-6.0B sales outlook supports near-term recovery catalyst; prolonged low lithium pricing remains key risk.

items.headline: The Zacks Analyst Blog Highlights Albemarle, Sociedad Quimica and Rio Tinto
items.snippet: ALB broke below 50-day and 200-day SMA, death cross July 21 2026, signaling bearish technical trend. Long-term lithium demand CAGR 10-20% expected 2025-2030.

items.headline: Albemarle (ALB) Q2 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
items.snippet: Global lithium consumption up 45% year-over-year through May, driven by stationary storage strength. Supply growth trailing demand; inventories near record lows. CGP3 fire pushed full run-rate to Q1 2027.

items.headline: Albemarle Corp: Investor Day on Aug 12, 2026 - Slides
items.snippet: 2026E outlook scenarios by lithium price: at $10/kg net sales $4.1-4.3B, at $20/kg $5.7-6.0B, at $30/kg $7.5-7.8B.

items.headline: Albemarle to Benefit From Low-cost Assets, Brownfield Opportunity, RBC Says
items.snippet: RBC Capital Markets outperform rating, price target cut to $157 from $166. Lithium prices came off in Q2 on supply concerns but market remains tight; demand growth outpacing supply.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $225 from $245 at Truist
items.snippet: Truist keeps Buy rating; valuation appears overly discounted given resilient lithium demand and constrained supply.
